name: cli

items.name: Bind
items.doc:
The flags struct T filled from c: given values, then env, then the
field defaults.
items.summary: The flags struct T filled from c: given values, then env, then the field defaults.

items.name: FlagsOf
items.doc:
The flags of a flags struct T: every field (bool, integers, floats,
string, []string for repeatable flags) unless @flag(skip: true); the
field's default value is the flag's default.
items.summary: The flags of a flags struct T: every field (bool, integers, floats, string, []string for repeatable flags) unless @flag(skip: true); the field's default value is the flag's default.

items.name: App
items.doc:
The application: global flags and the top-level commands. Without
Commands, App.Run runs Action.
items.summary: The application: global flags and the top-level commands.

members.name: Action
members.doc: Runs when the app has no Commands (or none was given and Action is set).
members.summary: Runs when the app has no Commands (or none was given and Action is set).

members.name: Out
members.doc: Where help and version text go (nil: stdout).
members.summary: Where help and version text go (nil: stdout).

members.name: Run
members.doc:
Parses args (os.Args() form: args[0] is the program) and runs the
selected command. Returns the process exit code.
members.summary: Parses args (os.Args() form: args[0] is the program) and runs the selected command.

members.name: HelpText
members.doc: The help text of the command at path (names after the app name).
members.summary: The help text of the command at path (names after the app name).

members.name: Completion
members.doc:
A completion script for shell "bash", "zsh" or "fish" (commands and
flags; source it from the shell's startup file).
members.summary: A completion script for shell "bash", "zsh" or "fish" (commands and flags; source it from the shell's startup file).

members.name: Args
members.doc: Positional arguments in the usage line, e.g. "<src> [dst]".
members.summary: Positional arguments in the usage line, e.g. "<src> [dst]".

members.name: Run
members.doc: Runs the command; nil for a group that only has subcommands.
members.summary: Runs the command; nil for a group that only has subcommands.

items.name: Context
items.doc: The parse state handed to Command.Run.
items.summary: The parse state handed to Command.Run.

members.name: String
members.doc: The last value given for flag name (or its env / default).
members.summary: The last value given for flag name (or its env / default).

members.name: Strings
members.doc: Every value given for a repeatable flag.
members.summary: Every value given for a repeatable flag.

members.name: IsSet
members.doc: True if the flag was given on the command line (or via its env).
members.summary: True if the flag was given on the command line (or via its env).

items.name: ExitCoder
items.doc:
An error returned by a command's Run that chooses the process exit code
of App.Run (its message is still printed): `func ExitCode() int`. Also
found through wrappers (`return find(x)?("find")` keeps the code).
items.summary: An error returned by a command's Run that chooses the process exit code of App.Run (its message is still printed): `func ExitCode() int`.

items.name: Flag
items.doc: One flag definition (normally built by FlagsOf).
items.summary: One flag definition (normally built by FlagsOf).

members.name: Field
members.doc: The struct field it binds to.
members.summary: The struct field it binds to.
